Help

Find quick answer for dashboard creation.

Top Help Articles

  1. Open Standard Tiles or My Tiles from the right panel.
  2. Click the + icon or drag the tile onto the dashboard.
  3. Move or resize the tile, then click Save.
  1. Click on a widget to select it.
  2. Drag the resize handle at the bottom-right corner.
  3. Release when the widget reaches the desired size.
  1. Use the filter bar at the top of the dashboard.
  2. Select Country, Sector, Business Unit, or other dimensions.
  3. The dashboard updates automatically.
  1. Click the Publish button in the top-right toolbar.
  2. Confirm the save in the prompt if shown.
  3. A success notification will confirm the dashboard was saved.
